title: Building Images: Gzip vs Zstd
summary: Docker images are downloaded as compressed layers and default to gzip compression. But is there a better option? We compare gzip and zstd compression methods to see which is best for building and pushing images.
body_text: When you pull (or push) a Docker image from a registry, what really happens behind the scenes? When you request an image, Docker first retrieves a manifest from the registry. This manifest contains crucial information about the image, such as its architecture, configuration, and most importantly, a list of layers (individual file system changes) that need to be downloaded. By default, Docker checks the manifest for a build that matches your system’s architecture (e.g., linux/amd64 ). If it finds a match, Docker retrieves a manifest specific to that architecture, which includes the layers that make up the image. docker manifest inspect hello-world@sha256:e2fc4e5012d16e7fe466f5291c476431beaa1f9b90a5c2125b493ed28e2aba57 { "schemaVersion" : 2 , "mediaType" : "application/vnd.oci.image.manifest.v1+json" , "config" : { "mediaType" : "application/vnd.oci.image.config.v1+json" , "digest" : "sha256:d2c94e258dcb3c5ac2798d32e1249e42ef01cba4841c2234249495f87264ac5a" , "size" : 581 }, "layers" : [ { "mediaType" : "application/vnd.oci.image.layer.v1.tar+gzip" , "digest" : "sha256:c1ec31eb59444d78df06a974d155e597c894ab4cda84f08294145e845394988e" , "size" : 2459 } ], "annotations" : { "org.opencontainers.image.revision" : "3fb6ebca4163bf5b9cc496ac3e8f11cb1e754aee" , "org.opencontainers.image.source" : "https://github.com/docker-library/hello-world.git#3fb6ebca4163bf5b9cc496ac3e8f11cb1e754aee:amd64/hello-world" , "org.opencontainers.image.url" : "https://hub.docker.com/_/hello-world" , "org.opencontainers.image.version" : "linux" } } You can see under layers.MediaType , the MIME type of the layer ends in tar+gzip . As you pull the image, Docker downloads these compressed layers and then extracts them into a filesystem on your machine. This is why you see messages like downloading , followed by extracting during the pull process: Pulling from library/rust c1e0ef7b956a: Pull complete 143d0f027108: Extracting [========================> ] 31.75MB/64.35MB When you push an image, Docker will automatically compress the layers with gzip before sending them to the registry. However, the buildx build or depot build commands give us much more control over our build process. We can specify the compression method we want to use while building and pushing using the --output flag. depot build . --output type=image,name= < registr y > / < namespac e > / < repositor y > : < ta g > ,compression= < compression metho d > ,oci-mediatypes=true,platform=linux/amd64 You can see in the BuildKit README the compression flag can be set to uncompressed , gzip (default), zstd , or estargz . We'll do a deeper drive on estargz in an upcoming post, as that is a bit of a special case. But what about the other options? What is Gzip? Gzip is the default compression method used by BuildKit and Docker (for instance, when you run the docker push command). Gzip is a wrapper around the DEFLATE algorithm, and has been the standard for general compression since the 90's. Gzip (unlike zip ) concatenates files together as a tar before compressing them, allowing for better compression than individually compressing files. The final compressed collection of files is called a tarball and has the extension .tar.gz . # The `-z` tells `tar` to use `gzip` to compress the files. tar -czvf myfiles.tar.gz myfiles The -z tells tar to use gzip to compress the files. One common complaint of gzip is that it is still a single-threaded application. For one reason or another, probably for compatibility due to how ubiquitous and long-standing gzip is, gzip has not been updated to take advantage of modern multi-core processors. There is however, a parallel implementation of gzip called pigz that can take advantage of multiple cores when compressing or decompressing files. We've talked before about how compression isn't free , but it is usually made up for in the time saved by transferring smaller files over the network. Depending on your specific use-case and data, you may want to consider using a different compression method, or maybe even no compression at all. If you were dealing with a machine that does not have a lot of spare CPU cycles, but does have a strong network connection, it would potentially be faster to pull uncompressed layers from your registry. However, there might be a best-of-both-worlds scenario with a newer compression algorithm like zstd . What is Zstd? Zstandard (zstd) was developed by Facebook in 2015 and open-sourced a year later. Since then it has been rapidly gaining support due to a number of modern features, but most significantly its strong decompression performance. Zstandard was designed with the intent of providing similar compression ratios to gzip , but with much faster decompression speeds. One of the largest differences out of the box, is zstd is a multi-threaded tool, while the time-tested gzip is still a single-threaded application. At it's core, Zstandard shares some similarities with gzip . Just like gzip is a wrapper around DEFLATE , Zstandard uses a combination of LZ77 dictionary-matching (used in DEFLATE ) with a different entropy encoding scheme. Benchmark Gzip vs Zstd This is not a comprehensive real-world benchmark, but this should give us a rough simulation of how the different compression methods will compare in the context of building and pushing a container image. In this test, we will build the PostHog/posthog Docker image as an uncompressed tarball and then compress and uncompress it using both gzip and zstd . In actuality, each layer would be compressed individually and there would be a little additional overhead in making multiple verification checks, but we will be running these all on the same machine ( depot-ubuntu-24.04-16 ) with 16 CPU cores, so the relative performance should be similar. Comparison of Compression Ratios By default, zstd is designed to perform similarly in compression ratio to gzip , though we can see it still has a slight edge. Both gzip and zstd have tunable compression levels, with zstd having a much larger range of options. In this test, we used the default compression levels for both gzip and zstd . Additionally, I've included zstd level 9 as it is a common choice for high compression without sacrificing too much speed. Comparison of Compression Times Clearly, being limited to a single thread is extremely detrimental to our build times. Interestingly, pigz (the parallel implementation of gzip ) will be used by containerd for decompression if it is installed on the host machine, but not for compression . Single-stream gzip considers the whole file as a single chunk, meaning excellent compression ratios but limited by the speed of a single thread. Gzip has an alternate mode that supports chunked compression, where the file is subdivided and compressed separately, and then finally concatenated together to form a tarball. This is ultimately the property that pigz leans on, compressing each chunk in parallel in a separate thread, completing work an order of magnitude faster. This sounds like a win all around. However, even with pigz present on the machine, Docker will still by default compress image layers using single-stream gzip for ecosystem compatibility. Although both gzip and pigz produce correct layers, they arrive at their tarballs slightly differently and thus produce layers of different sizes and hashes. When those layers are ultimately pushed to a registry, they'll be recognized as different images despite having identical uncompressed content. Docker as a platform is making a tradeoff here, preferring canonical images in Docker Hub at the expense of slower compression speeds. Depot, on the other hand, aims to be the fastest place to build software, and so we've placed a higher premium on compression speed. We've modified our builders to use pigz for faster compression out of the box. So if you are currently building with the depot build command, you are already taking advantage of multi-threaded compression. Zstandard is natively supported by containerd and can be used for both compression and decompression. Standard zstd compression is within a margin of error for compression time compared to pigz , and will theoretically be faster for decompression. In this test, using zstd at level 9 significantly increased the compression time while only providing a modest improvement in the compression ratio. It's a good idea to run similar benchmark tests with your own container builds to see what will ultimately be the best choice for you over the long term. Comparison of Decompression Times Often the most pertinent metric is our decompression time. If we were thinking of a Kubernetes deployment that needed to scale up quickly, we need to ensure that our images can be decompressed quickly. Zstandard is significantly faster in our test than pigz , and interestingly, decompressing zstd-9 was roughly the same (actually slightly faster in this run) as the default zstd compression level. So with a little more compute up front, some bandwidth can be saved in the pull process without affecting the decompression time. Luckily as we said before, pigz will be used by containerd for decompression if it is installed on the host machine, so we can still take advantage of parallel decompression in most situations. If you currently are using gzipped images, which is all images by default, you should definitely consider installing pigz on your host machine. Conclusion Determining the best option often comes down to various factors, such as data type, core count, and network speed. But in general, adding zstd to your builds is an easy "one-liner" improvement that can save time, bandwidth, and potentially money. Where zstd truly shines is in its decompression speed, which in this test was nearly 60% faster than pigz while producing a smaller file than gzip in the compression stage. That is an easy way to get your pods starting roughly twice as fast or save on your CI/CD bill. If you are building images with depot build , you are already benefiting from multi-threaded compression in your build process via pigz . Whether you are building images with depot build or docker buildx build , you can still benefit from faster decompression times by using zstd for your images by setting the --output flag to compression=zstd . - uses : depot/build-push-action@v1 with : context : . tags : '<org>/<image>:<tag>' outputs : 'compression=zstd,oci-mediatypes=true' Related posts Uncovering Disk I/O Bottlenecks in GitHub Actions BuildKit in depth: Docker's build engine explained How Depot speeds up Docker builds Kyle Tryon

title: Understanding Thermal Management for Advanced Air Mobility
summary: As with many vehicular and off-highway markets, aerospace is quickly seeking solutions to decarbonize and enhance mobility.
body_text: Blog Understanding Thermal Management for Advanced Air Mobility October 25, 2024 by YDP 0 Comments 277 Views As with many vehicular and off-highway markets, aerospace is quickly seeking solutions to decarbonize and enhance mobility. Among the vertical markets within aerospace, the Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) community is arguably paving the way. While revolutionizing the ability to electrify aircraft, the vision of flying with alternative energy sources is quickly becoming a reality. As battery technology allows greater power density, thermal challenges continue to accelerate. A balance between thermal dynamics and energy efficiency remains one of the most crucial factors in this new aircraft technology. The turbine engines used in traditional Vertical Take-off and Landing aircraft (VTOL) have a much wider operating temperature range than batteries in electric propulsion designs. Just like an Internal Combustion Engine (ICE) may need to be warmed up in cold temperatures, aircraft batteries may also need pre-conditioning in cold climates. Conversely, as the batteries discharge energy during different phases of flight and climate operations, cooling is necessary to keep them within an optimal operating range. Battery thermal management is crucial to maintaining battery performance, efficiency, and longevity. The varying phases of VTOL flight demand different thermal management solutions. Both active and passive thermal management technology can be used during takeoff, landing, hover, transition, and pre-flight staging. Transient heat spikes and dynamic heating and cooling phases force battery thermal technology to be smart and agile. While balancing the thermal aspects of electric aircraft, Size, Weight, and Power-Cost (SWaP-C) are equally important when considering an electric aircraft. Batteries are already introducing a challenging amount of size and weight to new Electrical Vertical Take-off and Landing (EVTOL) aircraft. A fully integrated thermal management solution may be the ideal route, while distributed systems can offer flexibility in design packaging. At Modine, we have already rolled out numerous smart solutions to solve the toughest thermal challenges in a variety of industries. body_text: Is it possible to start a career in tech when you're over 40? Despite the stereotype that the tech industry is only for young people, many individuals are considering this path later in life. body_text: Key takeaways about porn addiction resources and support groups Porn addiction support groups provide accountability, shared experience, and structured guidance to help break the cycle of compulsive use. Frequently asked questions about porn addiction resources and support groups What are the best resources for overcoming porn addiction? The best resources for overcoming porn addiction include support groups, therapy, and structured recovery platforms that provide accountability and behavior-change tools. These options include 12-step programs like Sex Addicts Anonymous and Sex and Love Addicts Anonymous, faith-based programs like Celebrate Recovery, secular approaches like SMART Recovery, and app-based platforms such as Relay and Fortify. Combining multiple forms of support often leads to stronger and more sustainable recovery outcomes. Is a recovery group necessary? Porn addiction often thrives in isolation and is reinforced by shame, which makes it harder to break without external support. Recovery groups provide accountability, shared experience, and practical strategies that help you stay consistent and manage urges more effectively over time. How do I stop watching porn? To stop watching porn, you need to remove triggers, replace the habit, and build accountability into your daily routine. This involves limiting access to explicit content, avoiding high-risk situations , and developing healthier responses to stress or boredom. . How long does it take to get over a porn addiction? It typically takes several weeks to notice improvement and several months to achieve stable recovery from porn addiction. The exact timeline depends on factors like frequency of use, underlying habits, and the level of support you have. What is porn addiction? Porn addiction is a compulsive pattern of pornography use that continues despite negative effects on mental health, relationships, or daily functioning. It is often driven by changes in the brain’s reward system, making it difficult to stop without intentional behavior change, support, and structured intervention. Relay is a therapist-backed group recovery program for pornography and unwanted sexual behavior, combining daily accountability, real-time urge support, and a private peer community. The Best Porn Addiction Resources And Support Groups Taking the first step toward overcoming a porn addiction often feels like walking out of a dark room into blinding sunlight. It is uncomfortable, disorienting, and heavy with the weight of secrets you’ve kept for years. But that discomfort is actually the first sign of healing. If you are reading this, you have already recognized the signs of porn addiction and moved past the hardest hurdle: acknowledging that your digital habits no longer align with the person you want to be. Recovery isn’t about willpower alone ; it’s about rewiring the way you connect with yourself and the world. While the journey is personal , it was never meant to be solitary. This guide will walk you through the most effective support networks to reduce pornography consumption, clinical treatment options, and immediate lifelines available to help you reclaim your life. Understanding the Path to Recovery Internet pornography addiction functions much like a chemical dependency. It hijacks the brain’s reward system, flooding it with dopamine until everyday joys feel muted and grey. Over time, what started as a casual escape through viewing pornography becomes a compulsory loop that affects your relationships with a family member or loved ones, your productivity, and your overall well-being. The path to addiction recovery is not a straight line, nor is it a quick fix. It is a process of "unlearning" the neuropathways that demand instant gratification. To navigate this, you need a map and a crew. Support groups provide the map , showing you the pitfalls others have faced, while professional counseling provides the deep internal work necessary to address the root causes of the behavior. Why Join a Support Group for Porn Addiction? Many people try to quit watching porn "cold turkey" in the privacy of their own rooms. While noble, this approach often fails because it leaves the underlying architecture of the addiction intact. Support groups change the environment in which the addiction lives. The Power of Shared Experience There is a profound chemical shift that happens when you sit in a room—virtual or physical—with others who mirror your struggle. For years, you may have felt like an anomaly or a "broken" person. Hearing someone else describe your exact thoughts and failures removes the "monster" status from your behavioral addiction. It turns a looming shadow into a manageable medical and psychological condition. Breaking the Cycle of Isolation and Shame Shame is the fuel that keeps addiction burning. It tells you that you are uniquely flawed, which drives you to hide, and that hiding leads back to the very behavior you’re trying to quit. Support groups act as a solvent for shame. By bringing your secrets into the light of a supportive community, they lose their power over you. You stop being a "porn addict" in isolation and start being a person in recovery among peers. The Best Support Groups for Porn Addiction Different people require different frameworks. Whether you prefer a spiritual approach, a scientific one, or a peer-led community, there is a group designed for your specific needs. Which Porn Addiction Resource Is Right for You? Best for structure and long-term recovery: SAA / SLAA Best for faith-based recovery: Celebrate Recovery Best for real-time accountability and modern tools : Relay Best for science-based, self-directed recovery: SMART Recovery Best for younger users and app-based learning: Fortify If you’ve tried quitting on your own and failed, you likely don’t need more information—you need real-time support and accountability, which is where platforms like Relay stand out. 1. Sex Addicts Anonymous (SAA) Modelled after the traditional 12-step program of Alcoholics Anonymous, SAA is perhaps the most well-known resource. It operates on the principle that "sexual sobriety" regarding addictive behaviors is defined by the individual in consultation with their sponsor. This flexibility allows members to define what healthy behavior looks like for them. It is a space of total anonymity where the only requirement for membership is a desire to stop compulsive sexual behavior and overcome sexual addiction . 2. Sex and Love Addicts Anonymous (SLAA) While similar to SAA, SLAA places a heavier emphasis on the emotional underpinnings of addiction—specifically how the use of pornography or fantasy is used to bridge a "hole in the soul." If you find that your porn use is deeply tied to a need for romantic validation or an escape from loneliness, SLAA’s focus on the intersection of love and sex can be incredibly illuminating. 3. Celebrate Recovery (CR) For those who want to integrate their faith into their healing, Celebrate Recovery is a Christ-centered 12-step program. It addresses "hurts, habits, and hang-ups" of all kinds. CR is widely available in churches across the globe and provides a massive, built-in community for those who find strength in biblical principles and communal worship. Relay Health (Relay) Relay is a modern, therapist-backed recovery platform designed specifically for people trying to quit pornography and regain control over their behavior. Unlike traditional 12-step programs that rely on scheduled meetings, Relay provides real-time accountability and intervention, helping you manage urges the moment they happen—not hours or days later. The platform combines daily check-ins, peer support, and structured behavior-change tools to interrupt patterns before they turn into a relapse . Instead of relying on willpower alone, Relay builds a system around you that makes consistency easier. What sets Relay apart is its flexibility in approach. Users can choose a psychology-based track grounded in behavioral science, or a combined psychology + faith path that integrates spiritual principles into the recovery process. This allows you to align your recovery with your personal beliefs while still benefiting from proven methods. The result is a system that doesn’t just teach recovery—it helps you practice it in real time, every day. 5. Fortify (Fight the New Drug) Fortify is a modern, tech-forward platform designed specifically for the digital age. Unlike traditional 12-step meetings, Fortify uses a "brain-based" approach. It offers a structured curriculum, accountability software tracking tools, and community forums. It is particularly popular among young adults and younger generations who want a science-backed understanding of how porn affects the brain and a community that communicates via apps and video. 6. SMART Recovery If you prefer a secular, cognitive-behavioral approach, SMART Recovery (Self-Management and Recovery Training) is an excellent choice. It focuses on empowerment rather than admitting powerlessness. Using tools like the "Cost-Benefit Analysis" and "Urge Log," SMART Recovery teaches you how to manage your thoughts and feelings through practical coping mechanisms and psychological techniques. Professional Counseling and Clinical Resources While support groups provide the community, professional therapy provides the surgery. Sometimes the addiction is a symptom of deeper trauma, anxiety, or depression that requires professional help a peer-led group isn't equipped to handle. Research shows that combining peer support with professional therapy significantly improves long-term recovery outcomes compared to attempting recovery alone. Seeking a Certified Sex Addiction Therapist (CSAT) Not all therapists are trained to handle the nuances of sexual compulsivity. A Certified Sex Addiction Therapist (CSAT) has undergone rigorous training specifically in this field, a framework pioneered by Dr. Patrick Carnes. They understand the cycle of betrayal trauma (if a partner is involved) and the specific neurological triggers of porn addiction. Working with a CSAT ensures you are getting clinical interventions based on the latest research. Inpatient vs. Outpatient Programs If your addiction has led to a total breakdown in your ability to function—loss of a job, divorce, or legal issues—an intensive program may be necessary. Inpatient programs provide a "digital detox" in a controlled environment for 30 to 90 days. Outpatient programs allow you to remain at home while attending several hours of therapy and group sessions per week. These are high-accountability options for those who need a hard reset. Immediate Help: Hotlines and Crisis Resources Sometimes the urge feels like a physical weight, or the shame leads to thoughts of self-harm. In those moments, you don't need a meeting next Tuesday; you need a voice right now. SAMHSA National Helpline The Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration (SAMHSA) offers a 24/7, 365-day-a-year treatment referral and information service. Call 1-800-662-HELP (4357) . They can direct you to local clinics, support groups, and community-based organizations. Crisis Text Line If you aren't comfortable speaking over the phone, the Crisis Text Line is an invaluable resource. Text HOME to 741741 to connect with a crisis counselor. It’s free, confidential, and available 24/7 to help you navigate a moment of intense distress. What to Look for in a Quality Support Network Not every group is a perfect fit. When evaluating a community, look for these three pillars to ensure it’s a healthy environment for your growth. Anonymity and Confidentiality A quality group must feel like a sanctuary. You should feel certain that what you share stays within those walls. This safety is what allows for the radical honesty required to heal. Structure and Accountability A group that is just a "venting session" rarely leads to long-term change. Look for a network that has a clear path forward—whether that’s a 12-step curriculum or a set of cognitive goals. There should be a system where members check in on one another and hold each other to their commitments. Inclusivity and Safety The best groups are those where everyone—regardless of gender, orientation, or background—feels welcome. Avoid groups that use "shame-based" tactics or excessive judgment. Recovery should be built on the pursuit of a better life, not the fear of punishment. How to Take the First Step Today The hardest part of this journey is the five minutes before you enter your first meeting or make your first call. Your brain will try to convince you that you can handle it tomorrow or that your case isn't "bad enough" yet. Ignore those voices. Today, your only job is to reach out. Pick one of the addiction resources from this list—whether it’s looking up a local SAA meeting or downloading the Fortify app—and engage with it. You don't have to figure out the next ten years; you just have to manage the next ten minutes. You have lived in the cycle of addiction long enough. It’s time to see what life looks like on the other side of the door. We're biased, but we think Relay is a great place to start.

title: Essential Bid Management Strategies for Real Estate Owners
summary: Learn essential bid management tips for real estate owners to cut costs, reduce delays, and enhance project outcomes with streamlined, effective strategies
body_text: A well-structured bidding process is critical for driving down costs and minimizing change orders and delays in capital and construction projects. With billions in project value managed through our platform by major real estate owners across North America, we've pinpointed where best practices truly matter—and where teams tend to stumble. Here’s a look at some of the most impactful bid management strategies to refine your process: Bid Management Best Practices 1. Keep Shared Documents Consistent Ensure every bidder receives all necessary documentation to understand the project scope. If you’re not using an automated bidding platform or an FTP site with read receipts, assign a junior project manager or coordinator to verify that each bidder has the latest document package. 2. Enforce Bid Deadlines Remind bidders of due dates a few days in advance and again on the deadline day. This small but often overlooked task reinforces the importance of your timeline. 3. Use Walkthroughs to Evaluate Bidders A site walkthrough allows bidders to examine project logistics and reveals how well they’ve reviewed the plans. Contractors who come prepared with specific questions are often those who have taken the time to understand the project’s details. 4. Require Electronic Submission of RFIs to All Relevant Parties By having bidders submit RFIs electronically to the project manager and the architect, you ensure prompt responses. Shared RFI documentation helps prevent contractors from omitting questions to later file costly change orders. 5. Distribute Addendums Promptly When the architect or engineer issues an update, distribute it to all bidders immediately. Timely updates keep bids accurate and prevent delays. 6. Break Down Items in Bid Leveling Watch for bidders who lump items together. If one bidder breaks out the fire alarm from the electrical system while another combines them, make adjustments to compare bids accurately. Note these adjustments and follow up with clarifying questions if necessary. 7. Push for Firm Bid Costs Over Allowances When bidders include allowances (estimates for uncertain costs), push them to replace these with firm numbers as quickly as possible. Firm pricing enables you to make more accurate comparisons. 8. Include Alternatives in the Bid Process Negotiating is most effective during the bid process, not after the contract is awarded. Include potential add-ons as alternates so that if you decide to proceed, you have a confirmed price from the winning bidder. 9. Select the Right Bid Group Size Opting for a smaller, targeted bid group can yield better prices. Contractors may invest more time and detail into their bids when they have a higher chance of winning. 10. Thank Losing Bidders After awarding a bid, remember to thank the unsuccessful bidders. Showing appreciation fosters positive relationships, encouraging vendors to keep submitting quality bids. 11. Consider Package Bidding For multiple, similar jobs around the same time, package bidding can provide economies of scale. Create separate bid forms for each scope but expect a discount if you award the entire package to one vendor. By implementing these strategies, real estate owners can bring more control, predictability, and scalability to their bidding processes, ultimately enhancing project outcomes.

body_text: Solving production issues autonomously is incredibly complex. Every engineer knows how critical it is to resolve production issues quickly, but this has historically been a challenge for AI. The problem isn’t just about the technical complexity—it’s about keeping up with the ever-changing landscape of production environments. Why is it so difficult? The Problem: Outdated Playbooks The response we heard from every company we spoke to was the same: playbooks are outdated. This isn’t just a minor inconvenience; it’s a major issue. As production environments evolve rapidly, the playbooks designed to guide engineers through troubleshooting become obsolete almost as fast as they’re written. For companies that are trying to move quickly, keeping these playbooks up to date is practically impossible. A New Approach: AI Autonomy Without Compromises When we realized that we couldn’t rely on outdated playbooks, we decided to explore new ways to make our AI agent truly autonomous. But as we tested different approaches, one thing became clear: Letting AI make every decision in real-time doesn’t work. The debugging search space is massive. There are an overwhelming number of checks that need to be run when investigating an issue. This made real-time, fully autonomous decision-making too slow and computationally expensive. So, what’s the solution? The key lies in finding a balance between fully automated responses and human intervention. What We’ve Learned About Building the Perfect On-Call Copilot Here are the lessons we’ve learned on our journey: ✨ Slack Is Gold A huge amount of troubleshooting happens in Slack—especially now that remote work is the norm. Slack conversations provide invaluable data: they show exactly what steps were taken, what checks were performed, and when. By integrating Slack into our system, we’re able to capture this information without adding any extra work for teams. It allows us to continually learn from each incident, improving the system’s efficiency over time. ✨ Coverage Grows with Use We’ve learned that as new issues arise, they don’t need to be a roadblock. If a team member runs a query for an issue we haven’t seen before, we simply add it to our automated responses for future use. This adaptive learning approach ensures that the AI agent is constantly improving and can handle a growing range of issues with each new challenge. ✨ Every Company Has Repetitive, Time-Consuming Checks While the specific checks may vary from one company to another, one thing is certain: every company has repetitive checks that waste engineers' time. Whether it’s reviewing logs, confirming configurations, or running basic diagnostics, these tasks are critical but time-consuming. Automating these repetitive tasks saves invaluable time for engineers, allowing them to focus on higher-value work—and it’s a game-changer in speeding up incident resolution. The Results: Cutting Investigation Time by Over 40% By combining these insights and finding the right balance between automation and human input, we’ve been able to cut investigation time by over 40% right from the start. But it doesn’t stop there. This approach continues to evolve, with each new incident feeding data back into the system and driving even faster resolutions. What’s Next? As we continue to refine our on-call copilot, we’re working to nail that perfect balance between automation and human expertise. title: Como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos? 9 práticas essenciais!
summary: Veja como gerenciar cadeia de suprimentos a partir de 9 práticas, as vantagens desse gerenciamento para a sua empresa + 4 dicas de aprimoramento
body_text: **Saber como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos da sua empresa é uma ótima maneira de melhorar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos, se adequar em menos tempo às mudanças do mercado e garantir a qualidade dos produtos e/ou serviços comercializados. ** A soma de todos esses pontos gera vantagens como aumento do poder competitivo da marca, conquista de mais espaço no mercado e aprimoramento do relacionamento com o consumidor, que receberá bens e serviços alinhados às suas expectativas. Como você pode ver, descobrir como fazer uma gestão de cadeia de suprimentos eficiente está diretamente relacionado ao sucesso de uma empresa, pois esse resultado não é baseado apenas nos lucros gerados. Um bom relacionamento com os clientes, por exemplo, é parte desse processo, e o gerenciamento da rede de abastecimento tem papel importante. Um dos motivos é que, sem uma cadeia de suprimentos confiável, é praticamente impossível entregar qualidade e garantir prazos aos consumidores (para quem atua no mercado B2C) e aos contratantes (para negócios B2B). Portanto, o segredo está em descobrir como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos com equilíbrio entre as necessidades e expectativas do contratante e capacidade de fornecimento do contrato. E sem deixar de lado questões legais e o alcance de um bom custo-benefício. Como realizar esse gerenciamento? Siga a leitura e confira nove práticas essenciais! O que é a cadeia de suprimentos? **A cadeia de suprimentos é o conjunto de atividades, estratégias, ações e agentes que participam de um ou mais processos de fabricação e entrega de produtos, ou criação e prestação de serviços aos clientes finais. ** Alguns exemplos de participantes dessa rede são: fornecedores; produtores; distribuidores; varejistas. Entre as tarefas características da cadeia de suprimentos, estão: armazenamento; controle de estoque; gestão de demanda; atendimento do cliente ; logística. Sugestão de leitura: “ O que é logística sustentável e qual a importância? ” O que é gestão da cadeia de suprimentos? **A gestão da cadeia de suprimentos — ou SCM, Supply Chain Management — consiste na administração dos agentes que a compõem e de diversas atividades relacionadas a essa rede, a exemplo de fabricação e entrega de produtos/serviços aos consumidores. ** Esse gerenciamento vai desde a compra de insumos, matérias-primas e contratação de terceiros, e até a entrega do item ou solução ao cliente final. Por esse motivo, a gestão da cadeia de suprimentos (SCM) inclui práticas como: logística ; gerenciamento de fornecedores ; controle de fluxo de compras; definição de processos de vendas; estratégias de marketing ; controle de estoque. Quais as vantagens de uma gestão eficiente da cadeia de suprimentos? É importante você saber como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos da sua empresa porque essa atividade traz vantagens como: redução de custos : por meio de uma SCM eficiente fica mais fácil visualizar como o dinheiro é empregado em atividades como armazenamento e transporte de insumos. Dessa forma, é possível identificar perdas financeiras e oportunidades de eliminar gastos desnecessários; aumento da eficiência operacional : decorrente do reconhecimento de processos e fluxos, o que gera a chance de eliminar gargalos; garantia de qualidade : a partir do acompanhamento dessa característica em todas as etapas do ciclo vida do produto ou serviço; melhora da gestão de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos : com análise de ameaças como interrupção no fornecimento ou problemas jurídicos, e elaboração de medidas para mitigar ou até mesmo eliminar as ameaças; adequação mais rápida às mudanças : um dos resultados de conhecer bem os fornecedores e construir relacionamentos estratégicos com esses parceiros comerciais. Qual o segredo para gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos corretamente? Ao contrário do que muitos gestores ainda pensam, a cadeia de suprimentos não é apenas focada na gestão logística dos produtos ou serviços — apesar de ser o ponto-chave. **Todo o gerenciamento da rede de fornecimento precisa ser ágil, produtivo e com custo controlado para potencializar os resultados da empresa. ** A administração por meio de estratégias de relacionamento, integração externa com fornecedores e clientes são pontos principais de como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos de maneira assertiva. Em linhas gerais, um bom gerenciamento se resume a **planejamento e controle. ** Inclusive, esse plano deve contemplar todo o percurso dos recursos, desde o início do processo de aquisição de matéria-prima até a entrega do produto/serviço ao consumidor. Esse fluxo está diretamente atrelado à gestão de fornecedores, negociação, transporte, qualidade e distribuição das mercadorias. O controle da rede de suprimentos, por sua vez, é baseado no domínio das informações e contingência de imprevistos operacionais. Dica! Não deixe de ler o artigo: “ Supply Chain: quais os principais desafios e como superá-los? ” Como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos corretamente? 9 práticas! Se você precisa descobrir como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos da sua empresa com assertividade, inclua nessa tarefa as seguintes práticas: mapeamento de processos; plano estratégico; comunicação com os fornecedores; gerenciamento de estoque; controle do fluxo produtivo; logística e distribuição; gestão de riscos; promoção de sustentabilidade; relacionamento com o cliente. Confira os motivos abaixo. 1. Mapeamento de processos A prática de mapear os procedimentos, ações, atividades e tarefas executadas na empresa deve fazer parte do dia a dia da cadeia de suprimentos. Porém, também é de extrema importância o acompanhamento de seu desenvolvimento. A partir da assistência dos processos, é possível avaliar o desempenho das atividades em todo fluxo da cadeia e, assim, realizar melhorias nas etapas que houver necessidade. 2. Plano estratégico O plano estratégico consiste em estabelecer os objetivos da gestão da cadeia de suprimentos (SCM) e alinhá-los aos da empresa. Por exemplo, se a alta direção definir a implementação de estratégias para reduzir custos e maximizar os lucros, a área de compras deve adotar práticas que contribuam com esses resultados, como o saving . 3. Comunicação com os fornecedores Não há como gerenciar a cadeia de suprimentos sem passar pela gestão de fornecedores, concorda? A atenção a esses parceiros comerciais deve começar na homologação e seguir pelo monitoramento do desempenho de cada um. Em complemento, um dos pontos cruciais para um bom gerenciamento da supply chain é estabelecer uma boa comunicação com os fornecedores e torná-los parte do processo operacional. O principal motivo é que o trabalho dessa rede deve acontecer de maneira integrada, e atuação desses parceiros são parte importante desse processo. Ademais, além de manter uma relação estratégica, é indicado conhecer profundamente a empresa fornecedora. Portanto, não se deve negligenciar os processos para estabelecer diretrizes, prazos, políticas e níveis de qualidade. 4. Gerenciamento de estoque Em um gerenciamento eficiente da cadeia de suprimentos, o estoque precisa se manter a níveis adequados. Afinal, a eficiência não está somente em não deixar faltar, mas também em não acumular itens sem necessidade. Antes de tudo, é importante tratar o planejamento de estoque como a base para a rede de fornecimento da empresa e, assim, controlar desperdícios e evitar gastos desnecessários e prejuízos. 5. Controle do fluxo produtivo Uma ótima prática para controlar o fluxo produtivo da sua empresa é por meio de um cronograma de produção. Essa ferramenta ajuda a, por exemplo, comprar a quantidade exata de insumos e matérias-primas e não gerar custos extras ou ruptura de estoque . Uma dica aqui é alinhar esse cronograma às estratégias de marketing e de vendas, pois essas atividades aumentam a procura dos clientes e, consequentemente, impactam na necessidade de produção. 6. Logística e distribuição O tempo necessário para receber uma matéria-prima afeta diversas atividades do seu negócio. Se houver atraso, por exemplo, as chances de não cumprir os prazos acordados com os clientes são altas. Um gerenciamento eficiente da cadeia de suprimentos inclui avaliar e mensurar os riscos que questões geográficas e de capacidade de distribuição causam. Softwares de controle e definição de rotas, bem como de rastreamento, ajudam a encontrar as melhores opções de transporte, diminuir custos e otimizar as entregas. 7. Gestão de riscos A gestão de riscos na cadeia de suprimentos consiste em levantar todas as ameaças às quais a sua empresa está sujeita, a exemplo dos econômicos, jurídicos, geográficos e financeiros, e criar planos para mitigá-los. A melhor forma de proteger o seu negócio dessas ameaças é analisar o trabalho de todos os agentes da sua rede de abastecimento e, a partir dessa percepção, ver como essas dinâmicas impactam suas atividades. Dica! A homologação de fornecedores é o momento ideal de fazer esse levantamento! 8. Promoção de sustentabilidade No que se refere à promoção da sustentabilidade na cadeia de suprimentos, o objetivo é garantir que todos os participantes dessa rede trabalhem de acordo com boas práticas socioambientais e de governança. Solicitar certidões ambientais e relatórios com os resultados das ações é a melhor estratégia para avaliar esse critério. Entenda a importância desse cuidado no artigo: “ Sustentabilidade na cadeia de fornecedores (ESG): Por que investir? “ 9. title: Introducing Snapshot Compare for Tiptap
summary: We’re excited to introduce Snapshot Compare for Tiptap, a new extension that makes tracking changes between document versions simple and visual—right within the editor. It helps you stay on top of every edit, bringing clarity and control to collaboration.
body_text: Why and how Snapshot Compare works Tracking changes in a document is often a tedious and error-prone endeavor. The smallest of edits can slip through unnoticed, causing problems later. Snapshot Compare ends this struggle by offering real-time, visual comparison of any two document versions—ensuring no change, however small, is overlooked. Snapshot Compare’s strengths lie in revealing what’s hidden in the collaboration process. Here’s how it helps: See changes at a glance : every change is highlighted right within the document, exactly where it occurred. Attribution made simple : color-coded changes let you instantly see who contributed what, bringing transparency and accountability to your workflow. Customize your view : like all Tiptap features, you can choose how the changes appear. Use custom colors, metadata, and highlights to fit your brand or specific customer needs. With Snapshot Compare, your users spend less time searching for edits and more time reviewing the actual changes. Collaboration becomes smoother, with fewer errors. Get started with Snapshot Compare Install Snapshot Compare alongside your existing Tiptap Collaboration and Document History extension, and you’ll have a complete toolkit for serious editing and version control. Integrate with Document History for complete version control Snapshot Compare pairs perfectly with the Document History extension . While Document History saves and manages versions, Snapshot Compare shows you the differences between them. Together, they give you full control over your document versions in one smooth workflow. It’s like a modern way of comparing drafts in Word. Document History stores each version; Snapshot Compare shows you the mark-up of what’s changed. A familiar feature from Word to GitHub If you’ve ever used Microsoft Word’s or Adobe Acrobat's Document Compare, Snapshot Compare will feel instantly familiar, just faster and better. It highlights edits directly in the document, showing what was added, deleted, or modified, and who made each change. Think of it like GitHub’s diff view screen, where every change is clearly highlighted. But instead of tracking code, you’ll let your users track document updates. Every edit is visible, and no change goes unnoticed. Use case: contract and report management Imagine you’re working on a high-stakes contract that keeps going back and forth between buyer and seller legal teams. Each time it returns, there are new edits. Every change matters and the devil is in the details. With Snapshot Compare, you can track every edit within the document itself, making the review and approval process faster and easier. In industries like finance, where every change in reports must be accounted for, Snapshot Compare highlights exactly what’s been changed (a bolded heading, a rewritten section, or an updated figure), so you can quickly assess if edits are meaningful or merely cosmetic. Snapshot Compare is also ideal for: Technical documentation : focus only on what changed in user manuals. Collaborative writing : manage edits from multiple contributors with ease. Content management system: review how the content evolved over time. No more manual combing through past versions. Snapshot Compare lets you easily see who changed what and whether those changes were substantial or just aesthetic. It can be the difference between changing critical clause or making a simple formatting tweak. Take control of your document workflow Every change, visible. Every contribution, clear. Snapshot Compare lets you focus on the work that matters, without getting lost in version control. Ready to simplify your document workflow? Get started with Snapshot Compare today or contact us for more information.

(NASDAQ: FTDR), the nation’s leading provider of home warranties, today announced it is expanding its agreement with Moen to install Moen Flo Smart Water Monitor and Shutoff, a water shut-off valve, in seven new states for customers who purchase Flo as part of certain marketing programs with home insurance providers. summary: Seattle’s lower income communities, particularly in the Central District and Rainier Valley, have endured decades of displacement. body_text: Seattle’s lower income communities, particularly in the Central District and Rainier Valley, have endured decades of displacement. Redlining, housing and employment discrimination, and predatory real estate practices have systematically denied many the opportunity to own homes and build wealth. Since the 1970s, families that once thrived in these neighborhoods have been pushed out, losing their homes and the generational wealth that could have provided future stability. Corvidae Co-op directly addresses these disparities by offering affordable, sustainable homeownership, welcoming back those who have been displaced. An Innovative Solution for Affordable, Sustainable Living Corvidae Co-op introduces a new model of shared-equity housing that balances individual and collective ownership. By creatively navigating housing and land use policies, the project consists of 10 co-op residences on two lots within single-family zoning guidelines. In an area where the median home price exceeds $875,000, and single-family homes often surpass $1 million, Corvidae stands out by offering more attainable housing. Instead of constructing two multi-million-dollar homes, the project delivers 10 residences, including four subsidized by the Seattle Office of Housing, with prices starting at $170,000. This model not only keeps purchase prices and living expenses low, but also allows residents to build individual equity while maintaining shared amenities, fostering both personal and community sustainability. Located in Rainier Valley, just a short walk from the Mount Baker Light Rail Station, Corvidae is 4-Star Built Green certified and designed with sustainability at its core. The project features ten 2-bedroom, 1-bedroom, and studio residences: 6 suites and 4 independent units, averaging 600 square feet each. The co-op design fosters a balance of shared and private spaces to allow for gatherings and shared experiences when desired. Partnerships Rooted in Equity and Vision Corvidae is a collaborative effort between Allied8, Frolic, and Green Canopy NODE. "This project wouldn’t have been possible without the dedication and collaboration of our partners," said Leah from Allied8. "I knew I had a committed team behind me, and that was invaluable. Purpose is what drives buy-in, and every partner brought their passion and expertise to ensure Corvidae Co-op could offer a sustainable, affordable pathway to homeownership." Allied8 , the architect and co-developer and original visionary investor behind Corvidae, led the design of the project, balancing the needs of individual residents with the collective good. The thoughtful layout of the homes and shared spaces reflects their deep understanding of how architecture can foster community and support equitable living. Frolic , co-developer alongside Allied8, brought a unique perspective to the project, ensuring that the co-op model remains financially accessible and replicable across other sites in Seattle. Their co-op model aligned with the project’s goal of creating long-term affordability for future generations. Green Canopy NODE , serving as both financial consultant and builder, brought expertise in sustainable development and affordable housing. With a strong commitment to equity and community, Green Canopy NODE ensured that Corvidae was not only financially viable but also met the highest standards of environmental sustainability and social impact. Other key partners include Urban Black , 1st Security Bank , and Rainier Valley Community Development Fund . A Replicable Model for the Future of Seattle Corvidae goes beyond being a standalone project, demonstrating how single-family zoning can be reimagined to create equitable and multigenerational housing across the city. With its shared-equity structure and focus on affordability, Corvidae offers a scalable solution to Seattle’s housing challenges. "Corvidae Co-op represents everything Green Canopy NODE stands for: sustainability, equity, and community. We’re grateful to have played a role in making this vision a reality, and it’s truly rewarding to see the positive impact it will have on future generations," shared Sam Lai, co-founder of Green Canopy NODE. Learn more about Corvidae: https://corvidaeco-op.com/ Partner with Green Canopy NODE on your next project: https://www.greencanopynode.com/development-services

title: Visualizing File Analysis with the Strelka UI
summary: An article by Paul Hutelmyer : This open-source tool conceived at Target plays a pivotal role in streamlining file analysis for enhanced threat detection.
body_text: In today's threat landscape, security professionals are bombarded with complex files that demand deep understanding. Strelka , a powerful file analysis framework developed by Target, empowers analysts to dissect and investigate hundreds of millions of files daily across networks and endpoints. While Strelka's raw output offers invaluable details in JSON format, efficiently grasping key relationships and visualizing intricate file structures can be challenging. Enter the Strelka UI , an open-source tool conceived at Target to bridge this gap. It provides a user-friendly interface specifically designed to visualize files, their characteristics, and how they interconnect. This blog post delves into the Strelka UI, exploring its features, practical applications, and its pivotal role in streamlining file analysis for enhanced threat detection. Transforming Raw Data into Insights To fully appreciate the utility of the Strelka UI, let us examine a file that has numerous child elements and a substantial amount of output data. In the example below, Strelka churned through a sample file, dissecting it, and providing us with a JSON formatted output that, while comprehensive, can be overwhelming due to the sheer volume and depth of the data. With the Strelka UI however, that same information is presented to analysts in an accessible format, extracting highlights and providing a visual view into the relationships between the submitted file, and files hidden within. The Strelka UI takes the extensive JSON output and parses it into a clear, manageable display, emphasizing key findings and illustrating the connections between the submitted file and its embedded components. Analysts can closely examine these relationships, as well as the extracted file metadata and scan results, through a straightforward interface. This design allows for rapid identification and analysis of nested files and their attributes, streamlining the process of determining potential security threats or investigating the file's contents. The UI effectively surfaces the most pertinent information, reducing the time required to analyze complex file systems and enhancing the accuracy of the analysis. Understanding Key Features of the Strelka UI To streamline file analysis, the Strelka UI offers an array of powerful features: Interactive Visualizations: A graphical representation of file relationships and structures enables users to quickly comprehend complex connections. File Content Exploration: Drill-down functionality allows users to inspect the contents of a file without the need for additional tools. Relationship Mapping: Users can see how files relate to one another, highlighting dependencies and potential propagation paths for malware. Highlighting of Suspicious Indicators: The UI automatically flags potential security concerns, drawing attention to critical areas for expedited investigation. Each feature serves real-world scenarios, from cybersecurity incident response to compliance auditing, ensuring that Strelka UI is versatile across multiple domains. Strelka UI Highlights Let’s look at three different scenarios in which the Strelka UI can assist in visualizing file analysis. File Archive Extraction Compressed files can present a challenge in understanding their content without extraction. Strelka simplifies this by automatically extracting and listing all the contents of an archive, providing a clear view of the files contained within. Moreover, Strelka’s capabilities extend to dealing with encrypted files: It can either attempt to brute force password decryption or use a provided list of known passwords to unlock and extract these files. In the above example scenario, we see a zip file that has been submitted to Strelka for analysis. The UI clearly displays each file extracted from the archive, along with their file types and any highlights that indicate their relationship to the parent file. Additionally, integration with external tools like VirusTotal can provide immediate insights into the safety of each file, flagging any malicious content within the archive. Optical Character Recognition and Image Analysis Strelka also can provide context and details pertaining to images. This can be useful in examining documents and images sourced from emails or phishing attempts. It is equipped to analyze images within documents to extract and render text visible, which can be used in searching and detecting known patterns in phishing. The Strelka UI provides analysts with preview thumbnails via a hover-over action on the “Camera” icon, or by inspecting details in the “Optical Character Recognition” section. In the above example, we observe how Strelka successfully extracted textual content from a PDF file and displays images of the content. The UI shows a thumbnail of the PDF, making any embedded images directly viewable. Strelka's analysis does not stop there; it extracts text from these images as well as metadata, pinpointing suspicious domains, IP addresses, or other Indicators of Compromise (IoCs) that signal potential threats. Script Analysis Strelka can also analyze web content such as HTML pages, where it can dissect and extract scripts, uncovering the underlying functions, operators, and structural elements. The following is a view into an HTML file and the scripts observed from that file. In the above HTML analysis, Strelka deconstructed the webpage to reveal any embedded scripts. The extracted data, including functions and operators, is displayed, providing a comprehensive view of the script's components. Although VirusTotal may flag the content as malicious, the dissection performed by Strelka offers additional confirmation of the content's suspicious nature. Like the OCR example, we can see that Strelka has also extracted an IoC from the webpage. This IoC, which could be a suspicious domain or script source, serves as an additional data point for file disposition. Contact, Feedback, and Assistance As cyber threats evolve in complexity, tools like Strelka UI are essential for empowering security professionals to keep pace. In today's landscape, simply possessing data is not enough. The ability to swiftly understand and derive insights from it is crucial. Strelka UI facilitates this understanding, enabling analysts to visualize complex file structures and expose potential threats. This streamlined analysis promotes efficient decision-making and a rapid response to security incidents. Strelka UI demonstrates the strength of open-source collaboration and a commitment to advancing cybersecurity solutions. By releasing this tool, Target aims to assist the broader community in building a strong defensive posture. If you are interested in utilizing Strelka UI, you can find it along with the Strelka platform on GitHub . If you have any questions, concerns, or feedback, we encourage you to explore its capabilities and share your feedback in the Strelka UI repository . body_text: Drone and drone components manufacturer Unusual Machines (UMAC) announced the pricing of a private placement with institutional investors, securing approximately $1.96 million in gross cash proceeds. ORLANDO, FL / ACCESSWIRE / October 29, 2024 / Unusual Machines, Inc. (NYSE American:UMAC) ("Unusual Machines" or the "Company"), a drone and drone components manufacturer, today announced the pricing of a private placement with certain institutional investors. The aggregate gross cash proceeds were approximately $1.96 million, before deducting fees to the placement agent and other offering expenses payable by the Company. title: Unlocking Youth: Discovering the Best Skincare for Aging Skin
summary: When it comes to mature skin, it's important to look for ingredients that combat signs of aging: fine lines and wrinkles, loss of firmness, loss of elasticity, dark spots and drier skin. Here’s a comprehensive breakdown of the ingredients to look for to address these concerns.
body_text: When it comes to mature skin, it's important to look for ingredients that combat signs of aging: fine lines and wrinkles, loss of firmness, loss of elasticity, dark spots and drier skin. Here’s a comprehensive breakdown of the ingredients to look for to address these concerns. Hyaluronic Acid If you’re looking to minimize the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, the main ingredient to add to your routine is Hyaluronic Acid. Hyaluronic Acid is naturally occurring in our skin and is responsible for binding water for maximum hydration. When skin is adequately hydrated, the water content produces a plumping effect that can reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles by making the skin appear more soft and supple. Some effective HA infused products to incorporate into your routine are our Honest® Ageless Firm + Even Serum , Honest® Ageless Firm + Smooth Cream , Hydrogel Deep Hydration Hyaluronic Acid Serum , Hydrogel Cream , Daily Green Juice Antioxidant Super Serum , Vitamin C Radiance Serum , and Honestly Pure Retinyl™ Serum . Collagen + Elastin According to the American Academy of Dermatology, after the age of 20, our collagen production starts to decline ~1% every year; even worse, women lose ~30% of their collagen production during menopause. Collagen is an extremely important building block to youthful-looking skin and is the most abundant type of protein in our body. When choosing a product with collagen, it's important to look for collagen peptides or polypeptides. Ingredients like “collagen” and “vegan collagen” are too large to penetrate the skin surface, meaning their efficacy is minimal to none. Collagen polypeptides, like Polypeptide-121 in our Honest® Ageless line are small enough to penetrate the skin surface. Incorporating collagen polypeptides into your skincare routine can help improve the look of firmness. Youthful skin has that bounce back effect thanks to elastin – a protein in the skin that adds elasticity and flexibility. Elastin also plays a role in pore size and when combined with collagen, overall skin firmness. Age is not the only factor that contributes to elastin loss, UV light and pollution also lead to the decrease in elastin in the skin. Historically, there have not been many elastin-based ingredients, as “elastin” or “vegan elastin” are too large to penetrate the skin. Elastin polypeptides, like sh-Polypeptide-50 in our Honest® Ageless Line, are smaller than the full elastin protein. Using elastin polypeptides in your skincare routine can help improve the appearance of firm, bouncy skin. For the perfect blend of Collagen and Elastin Polypeptides, add Honest® Ageless Firm + Even Serum and Honest® Ageless Firm + Smooth Cream both formulated with these powerhouse ingredients. Retinoids Retinoids come in many different forms and are often introduced under the prescription name “Tretinoin” which is prescribed by dermatologists for acne. However, it is also great for aging skin as both a preventative and active ingredient to target fine lines, wrinkles, and discoloration. The Retinyl Linoleate, a retinol derivative, in our Honestly Pure Retinyl™ Serum helps to exfoliate leading to smoother, more even-looking skin. When adding retinoids into your routine, start slowly, using every few nights until skin has acclimated. It's extremely important to wear SPF during the day while using retinoids as they may increase sun sensitivity. Vitamin C Hyperpigmentation and melasma are a natural part of aging and are caused by hormone changes, UV damage, and even genetics. While it may be hard to completely avoid discoloration, Vitamin C is a great ingredient to help reduce the appearance of new dark spots. It’s also a great addition to your morning skincare routine as it helps improve the overall tone of your skin. Our Vitamin C Radiance Serum contains a blend of both Vitamin C and Diglucosyl Gallic Acid. For individuals who may not tolerate Vitamin C, our Honest® Ageless Firm + Even Serum uses Star Lily Flower Extract which helps improve the appearance of dark spots and is known to visibly brighten the skin, making it a good alternative for those sensitive to Vitamin C. Oils and Emollients An aspect of skin aging is chronic dryness. As skin ages, oil production declines, cell renewal declines, and there are hormonal changes - all which contribute to a weakened barrier and higher transepidermal water loss. This means skin becomes thinner and has a harder time holding water in the skin, therefore a moisturizer in an aging skincare routine needs to work hard. When looking for a good moisturizer, look for Squalane. Supplementing with Squalane is a great way to combat age related dryness. Our Hydrogel Cream is packed with plant-derived Squalane and leaves skin feeling hydrated and looking dewy. Skin repairs itself during sleep so going to bed with a heavy rich cream helps lock in all the moisture throughout the night. Our Honest® Ageless Firm + Smooth Cream contains a higher concentration of emollients than our standard moisturizers making it more suitable for dry or aging skin. The Most Important Part of an Aging Skin Care Routine: Prevention Protecting the skin against environmental aggressors will minimize the effects of things like UV light, pollution, and stress on the skin’s aging journey. Prevention should start as early as possible with the most important skincare product - sunscreen. Broad spectrum sunscreen protects the skin from UVA and UVB damage which have been shown to cause premature aging and skin cancer. Wearing SPF 30 daily, helps prevent the breakdown of precious collagen and elastin which impact skin firmness and youthful bounceback. This is the most important part of any aging skincare routine. The last important preventative aging skincare ingredients are antioxidants. Free radical damage can occur from UV exposure, environmental pollution and stressors. Antioxidants neutralize these free radicals and help to minimize their negative impact on the skin. Our Daily Green Juice Antioxidant Super Serum is the ultimate antioxidant serum, formulated with Goji Polypeptidoglycans, a Mushroom Complex, Carrot + Kale + Lemon extracts, and Green Tea Oil. Having a mindfully formulated, effective skincare routine is essential for optimum skin health as you age. body_text: Ambiq VP of HR, Kris Potrafka featured above with the A List Award for Series C+ Growth Catalyst. The award show hosted by Opportunity Austin and SXSW on October 23rd 2024, recognizes exemplary entrepreneurs, investors, and startups creating global solutions through innovative technologies and thriving in the Austin ecosystem. The Austin region serves as key tech hub in the semiconductor industry for its population of engineers, students, and innovative companies that push the boundaries of technology. For the last 14 years, Ambiq has been a rising startup semiconductor company with the headquarters based in Austin. Ambiq, with its proprietary Sub-threshold Power Optimization Technology or “SPOT” platform, challenges conventional circuit logic about power efficiency in semiconductors to perform complex computations such as AI related tasks. In conventional circuitry, a device turns off if the power drops below 1.0 voltage of power. With SPOT, developers can run their devices significantly below the 1.0 voltage threshold, resulting in quadratic energy savings. This unrivaled energy efficiency enables manufacturers to design devices that run longer on a single charge or handle more complex workloads such as AI, without a dependence on the cloud. In March 2024, Ambiq announced their next generation Apollo510 MCU as their most powerful and energy efficient semiconductor yet. body_text: Are you interested in joining the fulfilling and lucrative field of technology but you just don’t know where to begin? Perhaps you’re looking to make a career change but jumping into the tech industry without experience seems intimidating. Don’t worry! Whether you’re just starting your career or looking for a change, there are plenty of options within tech for everyone. In this article, we’ll help guide you to your new job in the field, utilizing the following steps: Learn the fundamentals Get experience Create a plan for job applications. What is the Tech Industry? In simple terms, the tech field is made up of people who create, improve, and utilize technology. The type of roles you’ll find in tech include designing websites, creating apps, analyzing data, and improving user experiences. These are just a few of the ways to get involved, and new jobs are even being created as technology advances. Further, with technology evolving so quickly, it’s becoming a must to have technical skills to remain competitive in the job market, even in the non-technical industries. How Do I Know if the Tech Industry is Right for Me? With the tech industry’s promise of good pay, flexibility, work-life balance, and career growth, it’s no wonder you want to join! But you want to know if it’s the right fit before diving in. To figure out whether tech is the field for you, start by asking yourself a series of reflective questions: Am I interested in technology and how it works? Am I a continuous learner and willing to adapt to new technologies and trends? Do I enjoy collaborating with others and solving problems? Do I want to do fulfilling and creative work that makes a real world impact? What are my goals, values, interests, and salary objectives and do they align with a role in the tech industry? We also recommend researching current job postings to see what kind of positions are out there, and reaching out to people who currently hold titles in the positions that interest you to get the inside scoop from a real life perspective. Fortunately, there are so many current experts who are more than happy to share their knowledge and help you join the team. What Tech Jobs Can I Apply for with No Experience? If you’re entering the tech field without a technical background, worry not, there are plenty of jobs available that you will fit right into! Online job sites provide various postings for entry-level positions and people looking to break into tech. Some professionals have even successfully broken into the field by getting their foot in the door with a non-technical position at a tech company. Oftentimes, people are able to learn new technical skills once they’re working at the company, and some companies will even pay for you to continue your education. Some examples of tech entry level jobs include: Project management Web designer Digital marketer Technical writer Data analyst Cyber security analyst Customer service manager Social media manager Technical recruiter All these roles offer entry level positions that you can acquire either by using your current skills thanks to your current professional background, or by gaining new skills through online tutorials or a bootcamp. Additionally, you may have noticed a brief mention of user experiences earlier in the article. What is user experience? UX and UI are about designing websites and apps that are easy, enjoyable, and aesthetically pleasing to use so that users will continue to use them without frustration or dissatisfaction. This is especially critical as we hurl forward into a society that heavily relies on technology. Specific titles you will find in the UX field include: UX Designer UI Designer UX Writer UX Researcher UX Strategist UX Manager Product Designer Check out this article for more in depth information and comparisons of each role. UX/UI design is a great field within tech that calls for designers of various professional backgrounds and does not require technical skills like coding. In fact, many successful UX/UI designers entered the field with no technical skills, and share that most companies value the fresh outlook provided by individuals, like you, who adapt their own skills and backgrounds to the field. So what skills do you need for this role? Essential skills in UX and UI design include communication, problem-solving, empathy, and creativity. This is why so many teachers, nurses, and writers make great UX designers. The more technical skills can be taught through a bootcamp or self-learning. What Skills do I Need to Break Into Tech? Breaking into the tech industry is fully possible thanks to the flexibility of skills. While technical skills increase your odds of landing a job in tech, it is not necessary to have them right away. Many employers are ditching formal education, prioritizing fresh perspectives, diverse backgrounds, and real world skills. Further, with willingness to learn, discipline, and dedication to your training, you can pick up the necessary tech skills for your dream job. Let’s review the type of skills you’ll need and benefit from: Technical skills: Your required technical skills will depend on the role you choose with options such as programming languages, design tools, web development, data analysis, and cybersecurity. Soft skills: Communication, problem-solving, teamwork, and empathy. Project management skills: The ability to manage projects, timelines, and resources. Creative and critical thinking: Think outside the box and approach problems from different angles. Continuous learning: With the tech industry constantly evolving, it’s important to have adaptability, initiative, curiosity, the willingness to learn, and be a self-starter. If you’re a beginner looking to develop or improve any of these skills then you’re in luck! There are so many online tools and resources at your disposal: Online tutorials Bootcamps Tech events Networking Mentorship Job boards Podcasts Blogs (like the one you’re currently reading on Avocademy’s the Guac ) Be sure to utilize these resources throughout your tech journey, but if you’re still worried about your lack of experience, take a breath and remember that we all have to start somewhere. How Can I Gain Experience in Tech? Now that we’ve discussed the various options in the tech field and their respective skills, you may be wondering how you can gain experience to land your first job. You may even be questioning, “Do I need a college degree in computer science?” You can, and it could work to your advantage, but you don’t have to. You can absolutely utilize your current skills while learning new technical skills, like coding or user experience, and gain the experience you need to break into tech through the learning route that works best for you. That could be through a university degree, a bootcamp or certificate program, or through self learning. What’s important is that you commit to the work. A good guide to follow to gain experience in tech includes: Figure out your current skills, and what you’ll need to learn or improve upon. Enroll in a bootcamp/certification program, degree course, or online tutorials to learn the foundations. Practice, practice, and practice! You need to sharpen your skills. Build a portfolio that will showcase those skills and represent your experience. Find mentorship . Consider applying for an internship or completing volunteer projects for businesses and products you’re passionate about. Let your passion shine! Network, and then network some more. With an industry like UX design, what you really need is a portfolio to break into the field! A portfolio will showcase examples of your consistent practice to represent real-life experience, without a degree or previous experience in a paid position. Check out this article from the Guac for examples of UX portfolios that will get you hired. This is something you can learn on your own or through a bootcamp, but a bootcamp will equip you with necessary skills, practice, and a portfolio that shows real-life skills, while providing a supportive network and mentorship. And the news is you don’t need prior experience to join a bootcamp! How Can I Network in the Tech Industry without Any Connections? Networking can feel daunting, especially for newcomers, but it’s a crucial part of getting your dream job no matter the industry. When you’re new, it’s especially important to get to know industry professionals. Connecting with people who work in the roles and companies you’re working towards will help to make your transition easier, and your goals more attainable. By networking, you can find a support system, develop knowledge, gain mentorship, obtain insight, and maybe even earn a referral for your next job application. Is Having Tech Skills Essential in Today's Job Market? Even if you don't have a technical background, there are many non-technical background tech jobs available. Acquiring tech skills as a beginner can be challenging, but there are many resources available to help. With the right mindset and some guidance, you can successfully start a career in tech, remembering to maintain your motivation and seek out a supportive community. Developing soft skills, networking with industry professionals, and building a strong portfolio will help you successfully break into tech.
